episodes.title: Chapter 1
episodes.summary: Michael plans an elaborate surprise party for Colin's milestone birthday, but the night takes a devastating turn after a shocking revelation.

episodes.title: Chapter 2
episodes.summary: Reeling from the news of Colin's whereabouts, Michael tries to keep it together during a charity dinner attended by his rival and a sought-after client.

episodes.title: Chapter 3
episodes.summary: While dealing with his demanding new client, Michael receives a crash course in how to use a hookup app — and the importance of an intimate selfie.

episodes.title: Chapter 4
episodes.summary: While feeling betrayed by a friend, Michael lunches with his mother, learns about Colin's new addition and confronts some hard truths about himself.

episodes.title: Chapter 5
episodes.summary: Michael discovers how much dating has changed in the years since he was last single and attends a seminar with Suzanne to change his outlook on life.

episodes.title: Chapter 6
episodes.summary: At a roller disco event, Michael bumps into a guy with boyfriend potential. Claire zeroes in on an apartment, and Stanley goes on a date.

episodes.title: Chapter 7
episodes.summary: During a ski weekend with Stanley and Billy, Michael starts to spiral when he receives an update on Colin. Claire joins Suzanne for a night on the town.

episodes.title: Chapter 8
episodes.summary: Michael prepares to face Colin at the wedding of the Jonathans, where sobering news, blunt toasts and deep reflections make it a night to remember.
